title: Decision
description: Validates the Codex Judge arbitration artifact for the Supervisor-CAO platform. A decision records the judge's ruling on disputed review findings. The ruling is one of OVERTURN (all findings invalid/fixed → approve), UPHOLD (at least one finding valid → do not approve), MIXED (some valid, some not), or UNRESOLVED (insufficient evidence → human review). PUBLIC schema: sanitized, contains no secrets, hostnames, or private paths.

decision_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the decision.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task whose dispute is being arbitrated.

dispute_id.description: Identifier of the dispute being arbitrated (optional for single-finding arbitrations).

candidate_sha.description: Git SHA of the candidate commit under dispute.

ruling.description: The judge's overall ruling on all findings. OVERTURN = all findings invalid/fixed, candidate should be approved. UPHOLD = at least one finding is valid, candidate should not be approved. MIXED = some findings valid, some not. UNRESOLVED = insufficient evidence to decide.

findings_rulings.description: Per-finding rulings (optional but recommended for transparency).

rationale.description: The judge's rationale for the overall ruling.

evidence_cited.description: List of evidence references (e.g. log paths, finding ids, code excerpts) cited in support of the ruling.

new_evidence_present.description: Whether the judge introduced new evidence not previously available to the reviewer or executor.

model.description: Identifier of the model that produced the decision.
